'''Barrange''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] wealthy being living in the city of [[Opolisti]] on [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Similarly to [[Avrak Villachor]], Barrange organized annual festivals.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
